metadata.title: Clicked like a sleep-deprived zombie and somehow popped 1 dude? Valorant aim is cursed
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like I forgot the controls
Enemy: wondering ‘Did that just happen?’
How did I even get that kill? No clue, but I’m taking it
Click if your aim ever takes a coffee break mid-game!

Tap if your panic clicks ever surprise even YOU!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckykill #funnygaming #shorts
